method: Source inspection and local automated execution

cases: poster uploads require a private matching active claim and never expose the author UID in the public URL
submitted suggestion images cannot be replaced or deleted through the upload API
cleanup requires a retired claim and cannot call the feed delete path
the existing account photo quota covers suggestions and the API rejects unsafe media and IDs
failed providers keep credentials private and reject cross-origin requests
failed poster cleanup reports an error without claiming deletion or exposing credentials
api.scope: Controlled Firebase/provider responses; no real Cloudinary request.

cases: poster claims are private, immutable and restricted to the signed-in owner
a suggestion can attach only its active owner-bound Cloudinary poster
discard and submission cannot race to remove an attached poster
reviewer publication must preserve the poster and never expose its private ownership claim
persistence.scope: Dedicated local Firestore Emulator; test-owned data only, loaded repository rules.

limits: Not a named teammate review or accepted backup role.
No live provider upload or production database write.
No new browser workflow or full suite run.
No student source explain-back is certified.
